description: This file defines the CityFinder class which provides utility methods to set location coordinates and retrieve city name using Android Location and Geocoder APIs.

classes.name: CityFinder
classes.description: Utility class for handling location-related operations such as setting coordinates and fetching city name from location.

methods.name: setLongitudeLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude and longitude in the LocationCord class based on the provided Location object.

methods.name: getCityNameUsingNetwork
methods.description: Returns the city name corresponding to the provided Location using reverse geocoding.
